Resolves #21717

Related: #21632 · #21346 · #21140

Restores the vertical column title inside collapsed `Neo.board.Column` strips (`resources/css/src/board/Column.css`). When `.neo-board-column-collapsed` switched `.neo-board-column-header` (`flex: none`) to `flex-direction: column`, `.neo-board-column-title` kept the row header's `flex: 1` (`1 1 0%`) + `overflow: hidden`, resolving its vertical main-axis height to `0px`. Setting `flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0;` on the collapsed title and `box-sizing: border-box; max-height: 100%;` on the collapsed header preserves natural `writing-mode: vertical-rl` sizing while keeping long titles bounded inside the column.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `ColumnCollapse.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI across all five themes + before/after rendered frames) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-3). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: CSS fix — 4-line flexbox sizing correction in `resources/css/src/board/Column.css` plus `ColumnCollapse.spec.mjs` geometry regression test.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — a 4-line CSS fix to the collapsed column's header and title, with its spec; no new primitive, config or contract.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The base title rule gives `.neo-board-column-title` `flex: 1`. That zero-basis share collapses to 0 px in the collapsed column's vertical header. At `b7e7c612e4`, `flex: 0 1 auto` plus `min-height: 0` gives the title its own length, and `max-height: 100%` with `box-sizing` keeps the header inside the column. I ran the spec on dev's `Column.css` and it fails at "neo-theme-neo-dark: collapsed vertical title height" (Received 0). With the head CSS it passes, alongside `WipLimits.spec.mjs` and `SwimlanesNL.spec.mjs` (12/12, both of which collapse columns). CI ran it in run 44854649111 (e2e-engine 5/15). I looked for a long vertical title being clipped, or the header overrunning its column, and found neither. On a board whose column reads "Waiting on customer", the collapsed title is 17 × 139 px with `scrollHeight === clientHeight`, and the 217 px header sits inside the 812 px column. The body's before/after frames are whole pages.

**Findings:** None.
